title: Add destination_v25: a linear planar error charge capped at -1 per control
summary: destination_v25 is destination_v23 whose planar error charge is -0.5 * min(|velocity - command| / bound, 2): linear, -0.5 at the evaluator's bound and at most -1 per control. The first native destination_v23 run met brief velocity spikes in Isaac: from update 140 its squared charge rose from -0.15 to -1.25 per control while the mean planar error only doubled. Its value loss also rose to 11000 within each episode; surrogate attempts 13 and 14 from the same v9 ghost_v11 start show the same within-episode rise after the 0.1 m/s step without the charge (action-limit charge falling to -2.4), and recover.
next: Requeue the native run as destination_v25 from the v9 ghost_v11 start.
